title: Cendol: Open Instruction-tuned Generative Large Language Models for Indonesian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the percentage of benign versus harmful sentences generated by the models using a translated version of the ToxiGen dataset, specifically targeting racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Chinese, Latino, Mexican, Middle Eastern, Native American).
Evaluating the models' toxicity and generation of harmful content toward religious identities (e.g., Jewish, Muslim) using the translated ToxiGen dataset.
Assessing the likelihood of the models producing toxic or implicitly hateful sentences targeted at the LGBTQ community using the translated ToxiGen dataset.
Measuring the models' propensity to generate harmful text against individuals with mental and physical disabilities using the translated ToxiGen dataset.
Evaluating the models' toxicity and generation of harmful sentences directed at women using the translated ToxiGen dataset.
